name: Omenpath Project
description: Niv-Mizzet's project to regulate and map the Omenpaths on Ravnica.

description_citations.text: "Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Proft reveals he decoded Kylox's cryptex and knows about the Omenpath Project.
timeline.quote: I know about the Omenpath Project.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 11: Portents and Omens
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 11: Portents and Omens" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Feb 2024.

timeline.summary: Proft cracks Kylox's cryptex, learns of the Omenpath Project, and offers consulting to Niv-Mizzet.
timeline.quote: Proft told the dragon that he knew about the project but would be willing to lend his skills to it for a consulting fee.

citation.text: "Alquist Proft", section "The Omenpath Project". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Etrata and Proft are contracted to assist Niv-Mizzet with the Omenpath Project.
timeline.quote: Etrata and Proft were ultimately contracted to assist the Firemind with his work.

citation.text: "Etrata", section "The Omenpath Project". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet recognizes the Omenpaths as a threat and devises a plan to regulate them.
timeline.quote: Niv-Mizzet recognized their patterns as a significant threat to the plane.

citation.text: "Ravnica", section "The Omenpath Project". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Niv-Mizzet directs agents across all guilds on the project.
relations.quote: You have agents across all the guilds, hard at work on different aspects of the same project.
